subject.title: feat: open Control UI links in a macOS sidebar browser

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor an in-app macOS sidebar browser for external Control UI HTTP(S) links, or keep the current default-browser behavior?
rationale: This adds a new native/web product surface for external web content inside the macOS app, and the protected `maintainer` label means automation should not decide or queue the implementation direction.

options.title: Sponsor scoped two-PR implementation
options.body: Proceed with the issue's split plan: first add a dormant host-detected Control UI bridge, then add the macOS WKWebView sidebar with explicit controls and proof.

options.title: Keep external browser behavior
options.body: Decline the in-app browser direction and keep external links leaving the macOS dashboard through the user's default browser.

options.title: Request a design/proof spike
options.body: Ask for a minimal prototype or security notes before accepting the product direction for arbitrary external pages in the app.

recommendation.title: Sponsor scoped two-PR implementation
recommendation.body: Proceed with the issue's split plan: first add a dormant host-detected Control UI bridge, then add the macOS WKWebView sidebar with explicit controls and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the product request and has recent history on the exact macOS dashboard window path.
